decision: Do not enable automatic full-PCM gate bypass. It generated text on the two-second noise control that the existing gate skipped. Reduced insertions on the other noise control do not remove this regression.
limitations: Two fixed controls, not an estimate of general no-speech error rates.
Transcriber time includes read, JNI decode, parsing and database commit; engine opening is separate. Zero gated time means the gate made no call.
Emulator timing does not establish phone performance, energy, thermals or background reliability.
No seven-language, continuous multiwindow, microphone-capture or held-out quality conclusion.
Speech and noise results come from separate attempts; the original incomplete run is not converted to PASS.
